title: Pollard-walk counts of 81 butterfly species on 39 transects of the Israeli Butterfly Monitoring Scheme (BMS-IL), 2009-2015
creator: Peer, Israel; Pe'er, Guy; Benyamini, Dubi; Schwartz-Tzachor, Racheli
citation: Peer I (2014). Israeli Butterfly Monitoring Scheme (BMS-IL). v6.17. ILS - Israeli Lepidopterists' society. Dataset/Samplingevent. https://doi.org/10.15468/q4lynx (CC0 1.0).
abstract: Volunteer Pollard walks of the Israeli Butterfly Monitoring Scheme: 39 transects of 50 m sections (300-600 m) across Israel, walked about every two weeks, mostly October to June, with every butterfly within 5 m counted per section. 1,846 walks from October 2009 to November 2015, 220 of them with no butterfly seen; counts summed over the sections of a walk; 81 species.
samplingProtocol: Pollard walk: the whole transect is walked (partial walks are not recorded), every butterfly within an imaginary 5 x 5 x 5 m cube counted per 50 m section; unidentified individuals recorded to family (not shipped); a walk with no butterfly recorded as an explicit absence event; start time and weather recorded per walk.
surveyEvidenceNote: A walk exists where event.txt has any row for its visit id: section events for walks with sightings and an explicit s00 absence event (Lepidoptera, 0) for each of the 221 walks with none; the protocol records only whole-transect walks. Two visit ids that are one empty walk of TR003 on 2014-10-29 are one survey.
closure: not assumed: visits every two weeks through a season of up to a year follow each species' flight period; period = monitoring season from 1 October

geographicCoverage.description: Israel, from the Golan and Galilee to the Negev (39 transects)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published, averaged: the centroid of each transect's section coordinates, uncertainty half the section spread + 25 m; TR017 has no coordinates in the source; no species is IUCN CR, EN or VU (checked through GBIF)

notShipped.section counts: summed over the sections of each walk into y (the EML's own instruction); section-level zeros cannot be evidenced because empty sections have no event
notShipped.records to family or order: Pieridae 314, Lycaenidae 166, Hesperiidae 26, Satyridae 20, Nymphalidae 15, Papilionidae 1 and Lepidoptera 1 records of unidentified butterflies; the species zeros at those walks stay as recorded
notShipped.recordedBy: volunteer names, replaced by pseudonymous observer ids
notShipped.infraspecificEpithet: one subspecies name per species where given; not part of the taxon code
notShipped.duplicate rows: 13 repeated event x taxon rows (visit 3481's Azanus jesous records over five sections appear twice) are summed as deposited
notShipped.measurementorfact temperature: values of 0 (240 section events) and above 50 are set to NA in obs_temperature_c
